article.title: The midterms show that Latinos could be a powerhouse force on climate
article.author: Editor
article.content: Latino voters are concerned about climate change – and among the most confident in their ability to create political change. The post The midterms show that Latinos could be a powerhouse force on climate appeared first on MR Online .
